category_title: Students with severe disabilities who use shouting and aggression to communicate basic needs
minimal_context: The student is sitting at the table during school mealtime and needs to request water and food.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for lunch. We are sitting at the table, and your food and water are right here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches directly for the water cup, ignoring the PECS symbols on the table, expecting to receive the water without having to ask.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you want? You need to tell me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins to rock back and forth in the chair, displaying stereotyped behaviors, and makes passive, frustrated vocalizations directed at the water.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I don't understand what you are trying to say. Just wait a minute.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts crying loudly and aggressively hits the table with both hands because the request for water was not quickly and correctly decoded.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for lunch. We are sitting at the table, and your food and water are right here.

STUDENT: (Reaches directly for the water cup, ignoring the PECS symbols on the table, expecting to receive the water without having to ask.)

TUTOR: What do you want? You need to tell me.

STUDENT: (Begins to rock back and forth in the chair, displaying stereotyped behaviors, and makes passive, frustrated vocalizations directed at the water.)

TUTOR: I don't understand what you are trying to say. Just wait a minute.

STUDENT: (Starts crying loudly and aggressively hits the table with both hands because the request for water was not quickly and correctly decoded.)

task.content: meeting some basic needs as receiving water, food, and pause
task.learning_goal: build gradually from simple to complex forms functional communication

context.materials: a word, a sign of photos, an image, a symbol (PECS)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Attempting to communicate primary instrumental needs (food, water, etc.) through nonverbal means that are not quickly and correctly decoded by those who assist
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: communication behavior as crying, crying, aggression directed towards oneself or the environment
related_quotes: Why should I say so many words, or show these items (PECS) when anyway I can receive what I want without asking?

behavior_patterns.condition: when functional communication is missing (or rarely occurs)
related_quotes: If you do not receive an item that you want, unless you properly formulate the request - give in exchange a word, a sign or a symbol/picture, and then there is nothing left for me but to obey
